name: toc
description: Table of Contents generated from Markdown headings. Three variants: static (inline, front-matter triggered), sticky (fixed sidebar via slot-toc block), interactive (sticky + IntersectionObserver scroll highlighting).

params.description: Enable static inline Table of Contents for this page (toc.variant = 'static')
params.effect: Renders a <nav class='toc'> with links to all headings on the page

params.description: TOC rendering variant: 'static' (inline, front-matter triggered) | 'sticky' (fixed right sidebar, slot-toc block) | 'interactive' (sticky + IntersectionObserver scroll highlighting)
params.effect: static: uses toc.html partial inside define 'main'. sticky/interactive: uses toc-sticky.html partial inside define 'slot-toc' in layout files.

js.note: Only loaded when toc.variant = 'interactive'. Requires .toc and .toc-header classes in HTML.

locked.reason: toc-interactive.js reads .toc, .toc-header, .toc-content classes and adds data-for attributes to links. Renaming breaks IntersectionObserver highlighting.

partials.note: Override to customize inline static TOC HTML
Override to customize sticky TOC HTML. Keep .toc, .toc-header, .toc-content classes (required by toc-interactive.js)

variant_usage.static: Add toc: true to page front-matter. Call {{- partial 'toc.html' . -}} inside {{ define 'main' }}.
variant_usage.sticky: Set params.toc.variant = 'sticky'. In layout file: {{ define 'slot-toc' }}{{- partial 'toc-sticky.html' . -}}{{ end }}
variant_usage.interactive: Set params.toc.variant = 'interactive'. Same as sticky. Also load toc-interactive.js in scripts-body-end/extra.html: {{- if eq .Site.Params.toc.variant 'interactive' -}}<script defer src='{{ "caps/toc/toc-interactive.js" | relURL }}'></script>{{- end -}}
